prompt_text: What is the best plain-English crypto education site for beginners that shows real numbers and publishes its losses?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean a site that (a) teaches crypto in plain English with worked examples using real numbers (fees, slippage, APR, on‑chain txs), or (b) actually publishes the teacher’s real trading/experiment P&L (including losses)? Those are different things — the first is common, the second is rare.

If you want plain-English beginners’ education that uses real numbers and on‑chain examples:
- Coin Bureau — very beginner‑friendly articles/videos; walks through tokenomics, fees, yields with concrete numbers.
- Bankless (newsletter + podcast + guides) — excellent for learning DeFi step‑by‑step and often shows real transaction examples and cost breakdowns.
- DeFi Dad (YouTube) — hands‑on tutorials where the creator shows live on‑chain transactions (wallet tx links, gas, slippage) so you see exact numbers.
- CoinMarketCap / CoinGecko “Learn/Alexandria” sections — approachable primers with numeric examples and links to sources.
- Glassnode & Messari — if you want the data side; they present on‑chain metrics and charts (more intermediate).

If you specifically want an educator or site that publishes its own losses / full P&L:
- Very few reputable educators do this. The closest matches are creators who link their on‑chain wallet addresses and publish all transactions (so you can verify gains and losses yourself). Look for teachers who provide wallet addresses and tx links (DeFi Dad and some Bankless contributors sometimes do this). Always verify on a block explorer.
- Be skeptical of anyone who claims large gains but won’t show on‑chain proof.

How I’d recommend proceeding
1. If you’re a total beginner, start with Coin Bureau + CoinGecko/CoinMarketCap Learn for plain English and numbers.  
2. To see true transparency, follow creators who publish wallet addresses/tx IDs so you can verify on‑chain — and always double‑check on Etherscan/Polygonscan/etc.  
3. Tell me what topic you care about most (buying/saving Bitcoin, DeFi yield farming, trading, security/how‑to‑self custody) and I’ll recommend the best single resource that matches your need and level.
